description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil samples collected from agricultural fields and sequenced for metagenomic analysis of microbial communities under varying environmental and seasonal conditions.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record.

sample_name.descr: Human-readable sample label or code used in the project.

collection_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Local time of sample collection, if available, in 24-hour format (HH:MM:SS).

season.descr: Season at time of collection; e.g., spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter.

field_site_name.descr: Name or code of the agricultural field or site.

country.descr: Country where the soil sample was collected.

region.descr: Administrative region, state, province, or district of the collection site.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling location in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling location in meters above sea level.

land_use_type.descr: Agricultural land-use category; e.g., cropland, pasture, orchard, greenhouse, mixed farming.

crop_type.descr: Primary crop present at the sampling site, if applicable.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of soil collected, in centimeters; e.g., 0-10 cm.

soil_layer.descr: Soil horizon or layer designation, if known; e.g., topsoil, subsoil, A horizon.

replicate_id.descr: Biological or field replicate identifier for the sample.

sample_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil collected for processing, in grams.

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture class or descriptor; e.g., sandy loam, clay loam, silt.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent water content or gravimetric/volumetric percentage, as defined by the study.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at collection in degrees Celsius.

ambient_air_temperature_c.descr: Air temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius, if recorded.

recent_rainfall_mm.descr: Recent precipitation prior to sampling, in millimeters, if available.

irrigation_status.descr: Whether the field was irrigated at or near collection time; true/false.

fertilizer_application.descr: Whether fertilizer had been applied recently at the site; true/false.

pesticide_application.descr: Whether pesticide or herbicide had been applied recently at the site; true/false.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect the soil sample; e.g., auger, corer, hand scoop.

sampled_depth_resolution_cm.descr: Thickness of the sampled interval in centimeters, if applicable.

sample_storage_temperature_c.descr: Temperature at which the sample was stored after collection, in degrees Celsius.

time_to_extraction_hours.descr: Elapsed time from collection to nucleic acid extraction, in hours.

storage_duration_hours.descr: Duration between collection and processing or extraction, in hours.

preservation_method.descr: Sample preservation method used; e.g., frozen, cooled on ice, DNA/RNA stabilization buffer, dried.

dna_extraction_kit.descr: Name and/or catalog identifier of the nucleic acid extraction kit or method.

extraction_protocol.descr: Brief description or identifier of the extraction protocol used.

extracted_nucleic_acid_type.descr: Type of nucleic acid extracted; e.g., DNA, RNA, total nucleic acid.

extract_yield_ng_per_ul.descr: Measured nucleic acid concentration after extraction, in ng/µL.

extract_purity_a260_a280.descr: Purity ratio A260/A280 of the extracted nucleic acid.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol used for sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used; e.g., Illumina NovaSeq, MiSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy used; e.g., shotgun metagenomics, paired-end, single-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Nominal read length in base pairs for the sequencing run.

library_insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate insert size of the sequencing library in base pairs, if applicable.

sequencing_center.descr: Facility or laboratory where sequencing was performed.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run identifier or accession code.

barcode_sequence.descr: Sample barcode or index sequence used for multiplexing, if applicable.

negative_control_included.descr: Indicates whether a negative extraction or library control was included.

positive_control_included.descr: Indicates whether a positive control or mock community was included.

bioinformatics_pipeline.descr: Name or identifier of the bioinformatics pipeline used for downstream processing, if relevant.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for taxonomic or functional annotation, if applicable.

taxonomic_annotation_method.descr: Method used for microbial taxonomic assignment; e.g., Kraken2, MetaPhlAn, 16S/marker-based, if applicable.

functional_annotation_method.descr: Method used for functional annotation; e.g., HUMAnN, eggNOG-mapper, KEGG-based, if applicable.

raw_data_accession.descr: Accession identifier for raw sequencing data in a public repository, if available.

processed_data_accession.descr: Accession identifier for processed or assembled data products, if available.

data_release_date.descr: Date when the data were released or made public, if applicable.

license.descr: Usage license or data-use terms, if applicable.

notes.descr: Additional free-text notes relevant to the sample, environment, or processing steps.
